g.text: Model analog of Wagner et al. Fig. 5, using a shared logarithmic scale instead of the paper’s image presentation. No laboratory panels are shown.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: C* = H c / M₀; C* = 1 is a uniformly mixed column. True spatial aspect ratio, no tiling, no spatial interpolation, no evolution renormalization.
